title: Margin + provenance pair (as served on a Box trade)
description: The margin figure and WHICH model produced it. Source: src/box/serialize.ts (margin, margin_source) + migrations/008_trade_margin_source.sql CHECK constraint + tests/pg/marginProvenance.test.mjs. Validated against a DIRECT serializer sample. The point of provenance: a dhan_per_leg_fallback figure over-states a hedged Box and must never read as a netted basket margin, so the model name is served alongside the number rather than collapsed to a boolean.
